limitations: The legacy reference INT8 end-to-end path reconstructs full FP16 weights and OOMed on T4; its failed row and pre-edit profile are preserved.
The reference microbenchmark uses one timed iteration per sample and five repetitions to avoid conflating model-level OOM with layer-level dequantization cost.
